_notes.title: The name on the page tab, the rail, and the felt.
_notes.playerName: Shown on the stats card; its initials go on a monogram card back.
_notes.draw: 1 to turn one card from the stock at a time, 3 to turn three.
_notes.scoring: "standard" (points, unlimited undo and passes) or "vegas" (the deck costs $52, each card on a foundation pays $5, the bank carries across games, no undo).
_notes.theme: "velvet-green", "midnight-blue", or "ivory-club": felt, rail wood, card backs, and the page's colors, each with a day and a night look.
_notes.cardBack: "classic", "lattice", "monogram" (the player's initials), or the path to your own picture beside this file, such as "my-back.png".
_notes.sound: true to play the card sounds, false for a silent table.
